busan-1-day-itinerary-long.title: Things to Do in Busan in One Day: Temple, Beach and Spa
busan-1-day-itinerary-long.summary: Follow Busan’s east coast for a day of sea views, temple steps, beach snacks and a Korean spa. This practical itinerary keeps the stops on one side of the city, with simple transport advice and options for a longer stay.

jeju-3-day-itinerary-long.title: Things to Do in Jeju Island: Easy 3-Day Itinerary
jeju-3-day-itinerary-long.summary: Plan three days in Jeju, from the turquoise west coast to Sunrise Peak and the south shore. Get a practical route, transport advice, and simple alternatives for rain, wind, or a mountain hike.

korea-7-day-itinerary-long.title: Korea in 7 Days: Seoul, Gyeongju and Busan Itinerary
korea-7-day-itinerary-long.summary: See how to spend a first week in Korea, from Seoul’s royal palace and a lantern-lit pond to Busan’s seaside temple and market food. This seven-day route covers the capital, ancient Gyeongju and coastal Busan, with practical choices for your day trip and journey south.

korea-10-day-itinerary-long.title: Korea 10-Day Itinerary: Seoul to Jeju, With Two-Week Options
korea-10-day-itinerary-long.summary: Ten days is enough to see Korea beyond Seoul: follow this easy route south to Jeonju, Gyeongju, Busan and Jeju. Want two weeks? We’ll also show you where to add the east coast.
